publicationGate: Publish only after approval of the exact inventory fingerprint by the owner or the explicitly delegated build reviewer, after separate exact-byte hash/privacy/fail-open review, and after PR #1 with S1c merges. The pack-publication PR must pass CI. Schema binding changes require a new exact fingerprint review.

governingSpecification.sessionWorkOrder: docs/sessions/S1c.md applies the shared evidence-contract rulings, overriding S1b where stated; S1b D3 staleness remains an overlay that leaves milestone verdicts unchanged.
governingSpecification.publicationHashMeaning: Exact LF bytes published with this pack; historical once DESIGN is revised. Build-time revision/hash remain authoritative.
